title: Capstone: Blueprint Simulation
body: End-to-end Blueprint simulation on a fictional company: value hypothesis, Visioning, prioritization, DITL, ROI, executive readout, validation path and MAP
kicker: 6 lessons · knowledge check at the end of this page
list_label: By the end of this module you can:
list: Execute every Blueprint step on a realistic scenario.
Defend value assumptions and the validation path in a live or recorded readout.
Meet the rubric threshold for the Specialist tier.
footnote: Recommended before this module: SBP-101 to SBP-113. Prerequisites are proposed; roadmap mappings are alignment only, not equivalency.
